title: termal_evaluate_acceptance's 409 "no acknowledged canonical naming history; request a fresh acceptance evaluation" names no usable remedy (the refused call is the remedy it suggests)
outcome: When an acceptance evaluation is refused because the work has no acknowledged canonical naming history, the refusal states the actual cause and an actionable remedy. For example: the claim's source root is not yet named and acknowledged; call termal_name_source_root for the worktree and request the evaluation in a later turn, or wait for an in-flight naming to be acknowledged. It never tells the caller to repeat the identical refused call. The refusal logic itself is unchanged.
acceptance: termal_evaluate_acceptance's 409 "no acknowledged canonical naming history; request a fresh acceptance evaluation" names no usable remedy (the refused call is the remedy it suggests) is done
